verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own AI-adjacent in-product capabilities: natural-language querying of telemetry data, Bits AI agents, and managed evaluations that flag issues (such as sensitive information or language mismatch) on a user's LLM spans. None of this is explicitly described as AI-generated insights or recommendations surfaced from the user's data, so support is thin and largely inferred. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights/suggestions (e.g., what Bits AI does with user data), coverage beyond LLM app evaluations and NL querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Query infrastructure resources and telemetry data using natural language or DDSQL syntax
including coding agents, knowledge agents, and Bits AI agents
Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
Flags the presence of sensitive or regulated information in model inputs or outputs
